posts.text: Twin Cities Correspondent @geno-bambino.bsky.social got this kind note today.
Episode 26: The Blue Kei Wave goes live in just a few minutes on irohpodcast.com and whereever you get your broadcasts.

Sorry for being late on the episode this week folks! Things have been hectic. I just started a new job, Caleb is currently eating cheese, and Geno is busy being a legend. So, I'm gonna get to editing tomorrow morning and get it out as soon as possible, preferably before Monday.

-Juice
